# staticnotes.org

> > A technical blog covering UK housing market analysis, data visualization, and software development tutorials

staticnotes.org features data-driven analysis of UK property markets using official sources like HM Land Registry and ONS, alongside practical developer guides for Git, SSH, and Python testing workflows.

## Key Topics

- UK housing market analysis
- HM Land Registry data
- Office for National Statistics (ONS)
- Real house prices and inflation adjustment
- UK House Price Index
- London property market
- SSH key configuration
- Github authentication
- pytest testing workflows
- ed25519 cryptography
- Property data analysis
- Housing statistics
- Git configuration
- Multiple account setup

## UK Housing Market Analysis

- [UK house price changes in real terms](https://staticnotes.org/posts/uk-house-prices): Analysis of UK house prices using HM Land Registry & ONS inflation data

## Developer Tutorials (TIL)

- [TIL how to set up multiple SSH keys (for multiple Github accounts)](https://staticnotes.org/til/2025/11/how-to-set-up-multiple-ssh-keys): Tutorial on configuring multiple SSH keys for different Github accounts
- [TIL how to re-run only failed tests](https://staticnotes.org/til/2025/11/pytest-rerun-failed): Guide to re-running failed pytest tests in Python development workflow
